title: Cross-Surface Authority Spine Schema v1
description: Canonical doctrine for the cross-surface authority spine — the single authority for all Rig Relay surfaces, protocols, and governance boundaries.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for this doctrine document.

doctrine_id.description: Unique identifier for this doctrine document.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this doctrine was generated.

effective_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this doctrine takes effect.

supersedes.description: List of doctrine IDs this document supersedes, or null if none.

source_audit_artifacts.description: List of source audit artifact paths or identifiers that informed this doctrine.

authority_tiers.description: Ordered list of authority tiers (Tier 0 through Tier 8).

surface_rules.description: Governance rules for each Rig Relay surface.

protocol_rules.description: Governance rules for each protocol surface.

hosted_team_rule.description: Governance rule for hosted team mode.

github_trust_spine_rule.description: Governance rule for the GitHub Trust Spine surface.

postgres_source_of_truth_rule.description: Governance rule for the Postgres source-of-truth surface.

telemetry_evidence_boundary_rule.description: Boundary rule distinguishing telemetry from evidence.

common_envelope_requirement.description: Requirement that all surfaces adopt a common envelope model.

forbidden_bypasses.description: List of forbidden bypass patterns that must be blocked.

do_not_overrun_guards.description: List of guards that must not be overrun during implementation.

required_tests_before_enabling_each_surf.description: Per-surface mapping of required test names before that surface can be enabled.

content_light.description: Content-light assertion: no raw tokens, secrets, or source code.
